properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.initial-size
properties.description: Initial size of Druid connection pool.

properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.min-idle
properties.description: Minimum number of idle connections in Druid pool.

properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.max-active
properties.description: Maximum number of active connections in Druid pool.

properties.name: spring.datasource.druid.max-wait
properties.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds to get a connection from Druid pool.

properties.name: oat.storage.large-payload.path
properties.description: File system path for storing large payload data that exceeds inline threshold.

properties.name: oat.storage.static-source.inline-threshold-bytes
properties.description: Threshold in bytes for storing static source code inline in database versus file system. Data smaller than this threshold is stored inline in DB.
